sources.label: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) 2017 Part 1, Article 2.20 — Residential Load Computation
sources.description: Provides standardized method for calculating residential electrical loads: general lighting (3 VA/sq.m.), small appliance circuits (2 @ 1,500 VA each), laundry circuit (1,500 VA), and appliance loads.

sources.label: PEC 2017, Table 2.20.1 — General Lighting Loads by Occupancy
sources.description: Table of unit load values (VA/sq.m.) for different occupancy types used in electrical load calculations for residential and commercial buildings.

sources.label: PEC 2017, Article 2.20.3 — Demand Factors for Residential Loads
sources.description: Provides demand factors applicable to residential load calculations: first 10 kVA at 100%, remainder at 40% (typical dwelling unit).
